create_SummarizationInput: create a SummarizationInput instance with text to summarize for inference
create_SummarizationParameters: create SummarizationParameters with truncation strategy and tokenization options
create_SummarizationOutput: create a SummarizationOutput instance from inference result containing summary text
summarize_text: summarize input text using SummarizationInput with optional SummarizationParameters
define_SummarizationTruncationStrategy: define SummarizationTruncationStrategy literal type for text truncation options
